svg.title: Yaru default cursor
svg.metadata: Adapted from Yaru Cursors by Sam Hewitt and the Ubuntu Yaru contributors. Source: https://github.com/ubuntu/yaru/blob/master/icons/src/cursors/source-cursors.svg License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ Changes: extracted the default pointer paths, normalized the viewport, simplified the gradient and omitted the original shadow filters.
